A1.evidence: Sec III-B: "split the local on-the-device dataset into training and testing sets in proportions of 80% and 20%"; "a stratified data split effectively ensures enough samples of the minority class".

A2.evidence: Table III: DNN and DBN with 38 input features per flow record; no windows/sequences.

A3.evidence: Sec III-B.2: "we perform the normalisation on each FL client independently" (StandardScaler, OrdinalEncoder); whether fit on the training portion only is not stated (Sec III-B, Fig. 1).

A4.evidence: Sec IV-A: "train the global DL models across 50 rounds and two epochs for each training round".

A5.evidence: Centralised baseline training epochs/budget not stated in Sec IV.

A6.evidence: Centralised baseline with same architectures run by authors; Sec IV-C: "we could not compare our results with other works".

A7.evidence: Weighted precision, recall, F1-score only; "the accuracy metric cannot be relied upon"; no MCC/balanced accuracy.

A8.evidence: Sec III-B: "group the data samples by destination IP address, select the top ten IPs... assign each IP's traffic to a single FL client"; Table II non-IID class distribution.

A9.evidence: No repeated runs, means, std or confidence intervals reported in Sec IV.

A10.evidence: Pre-trained weights from "the rest of the destination IP addresses" of TON_IoT; evaluation only on the clients' own TON_IoT 20% test splits.

A11.evidence: No code link or repository given.
